name: risk.account_capacity

list.description: Read native capacity snapshots for 1–10 explicit accounts.

parameters.name: account-alias
parameters.description: Repeat for 1–10 distinct nonempty native aliases. Acquisition queries the sorted explicit set; offline selection cannot expand saved coverage.

result_identity.description: Native aliasName must exactly echo the requested alias.

summary: Native capacity snapshots for an explicit account set.
purpose: Inspect account capacity without account discovery or changing funds, limits or configuration.

fields.name: aliasName
fields.meaning: Native account alias within the authorized origin/tenant; explicit requested-set identity. Sampled values were strings; optional native value types remain unchanged.

fields.name: currency
fields.meaning: Native currency attribute; not an additional identity or inferred currency audit. Sampled values were strings; optional native value types remain unchanged.

fields.name: accountAvailableBalance
fields.meaning: Native account available balance; UI Avl Bal, with no arithmetic or scaling. Sampled values were strings; optional native value types remain unchanged.

fields.name: availableIod
fields.meaning: Native available IOD; UI Avl IOD, unchanged. Sampled values were strings; optional native value types remain unchanged.

fields.name: availableResource
fields.meaning: Native availableResource; UI Outflow Capacity, distinct from outFlowCapacity. Sampled values were strings; optional native value types remain unchanged.

fields.name: cashPoolSupportAvailableResource
fields.meaning: Native cash-pool support attribute; business definition is unverified. Sampled values were strings; optional native value types remain unchanged.

fields.name: outFlowCapacity
fields.meaning: Native outFlowCapacity; distinct from availableResource, business definition unverified. Sampled values were strings; optional native value types remain unchanged.

fields.name: totalIod
fields.meaning: Native total IOD value, unchanged. Sampled values were strings; optional native value types remain unchanged.

fields.name: usedIod
fields.meaning: Native used IOD value, unchanged. Sampled values were strings; optional native value types remain unchanged.

fields.name: valueTime
fields.meaning: Native source-time string; timezone is unknown, distinct from fetched_at. Sampled values were strings; optional native value types remain unchanged.

identity_description: Native account alias, one validated object for every requested alias.
limitations: One GET per explicit alias with only aliasName; no tenant, date, paging or account discovery input. The 10-account limit is a client bound.
Any request, authentication, business, schema or alias-echo failure rejects the whole candidate. No skipped aliases, synthetic empty rows or capacity fallback.
Complete means every requested alias resolved; requested_count/resolved_count refer to that explicit set, and reported_total remains null.
Business output retains the ten assigned native capacity fields when present. Values, precision, null, empty, zero and negative amounts are unchanged; no scaling or inferred calculations.
availableResource and outFlowCapacity remain separate native fields. valueTime timezone is unknown. Sequential account inquiries do not establish an atomic snapshot.

Ordinary live does not publish; complete nonempty refresh saves the explicit set. Offline List replays that capture; changed account selections retain explicit coverage diagnostics. No public Get or history action.

examples.title: Acquire two explicit accounts
examples.command: dogopencli liquidity list risk.account_capacity --live --account-alias ACCOUNT_A --account-alias ACCOUNT_B --limit 0 --require-complete

examples.title: Read the saved explicit account set
